Privacy

This website uses no analytics, advertising, cookies, accounts, or server-side friend-card processing.

Friend-card data is placed in the URL fragment after #. Browsers do not send URL fragments in HTTP requests, so the friend card is not transmitted to this site or Cloudflare. The page reads it locally only to provide a copy fallback.

The CruiseMesh app stores identity, contacts, and messages on your device. Relay servers carry sealed encrypted envelopes and cannot read message contents.
